release_notes: Production release v1.0.6 build 8. PF Home / Assessment / Profile tab UX and data-accuracy improvements: time-aware greeting, pull-to-refresh, count badges, staggered animations, disabled Coming soon quick actions, corrected default form status from submitted to draft, profile cache isolation per account. Also includes the DownloadManager-based in-app Android updater from build 7.
Fixes: exclude draft schools from PF list, add startedAt to observation mirror, Android camera permission, remove unnecessary storage permissions. 24 migrations.

Production release v1.0.6 build 7. In-app Android update rebuilt on the system DownloadManager: APK downloads to the public Downloads folder with a system notification/progress and auto-launches the installer on completion. Fixes the previous Update Now flicker/return-to-dialog failure caused by missing Android 11+ install-intent package visibility.
Aikarthya Field Ops v1.0.4 build 4 — reporting pipeline foundation, mgmt shell, splash/profile polish.
Form field updates (school logo, school leader name, 1-2 qualification multiselect, year and month durations, teacher subjects free-text) plus the Classroom Observation submit RLS fix.
Build 2: Form submission reliability fixes, adapter numeric cast fixes, sync resilience improvements, GPS check-in fixes, RLS policy gaps resolved, attendance upsert idempotency.
In-app Android update flow: replaced broken installer with open_filex, fixed FileProvider authority, hardened download validation, auto-prompts once per session, stale-APK cleanup at provider init.
Production patch release (build 6). Splash screen background unified to #fefcfe and GIF edges blended.

Production release v1.0.7 build 10. Major update: AI Observation Reporting pipeline (chat-first Report Generation Studio with live streaming, scoring v2, DB-stored prompts and lockable templates, PF review/approval, notifications, PDF generation and share, queue dashboard) and the M&E Associate console (me_associate shares the management console with a Personal page, non-geofenced staff check-in, Completed Reports, an org-wide default reporting model, and a responsive mobile-friendly shell).

Production release v1.0.6 build 9. Observation form: Quick Check Q1 changed to 'What is the objective of today's class?' with help text; Section / Grade / Class Division fields now have help text; Closing section renamed 'Next Step' and moved after 'Grow'. PF UX fixes: bottom navigation haptic feedback restored; in-app auto-update now shows clearer progress and fallback actions (Retry / Open Downloads / Open Settings); Android installer intent hardened for reliable APK install.
